project_summary: Private clinic platform: patient portal with online co-payment, appointment booking, invoicing and ERP financial posting

components.name: Partial medical history exposure
components.description: Curated read-only view of active medication, upcoming appointments and reports, deliberately excluding sensitive clinical detail (historial parcial, medicación activa).

components.name: Accessibility & large-type patient UI
components.description: WCAG-conformant interface tuned for elderly and low-vision patients: large type, contrast, screen-reader flows (accesibilidad, letra grande, pacientes mayores).

components.name: Self-service booking journey
components.description: End-to-end patient booking flow across web and mobile with specialty and centre selection (reserva online, portal del paciente).

components.name: Multi-language patient experience
components.description: Locale routing and translated content across the portal and app (multi-idioma, castellano, catalán, inglés).

components.name: Patient profile & dependents management
components.description: Patient account with linked dependants and delegated access for carers (perfil del paciente, dependientes, acceso delegado).

components.name: Online payment flows
components.description: Card payment for co-payments through a standard gateway, before or after the visit (pasarela de pago, Redsys, Stripe, pago con tarjeta).

components.name: Medical act capture for billing
components.description: Record what was performed in each visit so it can be priced and invoiced (actos médicos, registro de la visita, facturación).

components.name: ERP bridge for financial posting
components.description: Push medical acts and collected payments into the corporate ERP where accounting lives (volcado al ERP, Business Central, contabilidad).

components.name: Refunds, fees & adjustments
components.description: Refund and adjustment flows with reason codes reconciled against the gateway (devoluciones, ajustes, conciliación).

components.name: Invoicing & receipts
components.description: Invoice and receipt generation with fiscal numbering and patient delivery (facturación, recibos, numeración fiscal).

components.name: Waiting list & no-show handling
components.description: Priority queue that reallocates freed slots, plus no-show marking and absenteeism tracking (lista de espera, absentismo, no presentados).

components.name: Booking engine with slot locking
components.description: Concurrent-safe slot reservation with pessimistic locking so two agents cannot take the same slot (motor de reserva, bloqueo de huecos, concurrencia).

components.name: Unified multi-centre appointment agenda
components.description: One booking calendar spanning a network of clinics, with per-centre calendars and central occupancy visibility (agenda unificada, red de centros, ocupación).

components.name: Management KPI definition
components.description: Agree the operational indicator set with the executive team before building (definición de KPI, indicadores de dirección).

components.name: Absenteeism & no-show analytics
components.description: No-show rate by centre, professional and appointment type, with trend analysis (tasa de absentismo, no presentados, tendencias).

components.name: Regulatory reporting to health authorities
components.description: Activity statistics and mandatory registries in the official formats, which change periodically (reporting regulatorio, administración sanitaria, formatos oficiales).

components.name: In-call document & image sharing
components.description: Share a document or an image with the patient during the live consultation (compartir documento, imagen en consulta).

components.name: Consultation recording policy & controls
components.description: Explicit no-recording enforcement with legal-hold exceptions and a consent notice (política de grabación, requisitos legales).

components.name: Teleconsultation billing events
components.description: Proof-of-consultation records emitted so a remote visit can be invoiced like a presential one (registro de consulta, facturación de teleconsulta).

components.name: Signalling, STUN and TURN infrastructure
components.description: Signalling server plus STUN/TURN relays and NAT traversal for reliable calls (señalización, servidores TURN, atravesado de NAT).

components.name: Session lifecycle management
components.description: Session creation, idle and absolute timeouts, and device listing (gestión de sesiones, caducidad, dispositivos).

components.name: Identity provider / SSO federation
components.description: Federate staff login with the corporate identity provider (federación de identidad, inicio de sesión único).

components.name: Multi-factor authentication for staff
components.description: TOTP enrolment, recovery codes and step-up authentication on sensitive actions (doble factor, códigos de recuperación, verificación adicional).

components.name: Token issuance & key publication
components.description: Asymmetric token signing with a rotating key set published for verifiers (emisión de tokens, rotación de claves, JWKS).

components.name: Refresh token rotation & revocation
components.description: Rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection and server-side revocation (rotación de tokens, revocación, detección de reutilización).

components.name: Multi-centre tenancy scoping
components.description: Row-level scoping so each site sees only its own data, enforced in the data layer (multi-centro, aislamiento de datos, ámbito por centro).

components.name: Routing, namespacing & API versioning
components.description: URL namespaces, versioning policy and deprecation headers (rutas, espacios de nombres, versionado de API).

components.name: Core schema, indexes & migrations
components.description: Entity model, reversible migration chain, constraints and index tuning (modelo de datos, migraciones, índices).

components.name: Pagination, filtering & response shaping
components.description: Cursor pagination, filter and sort parameters and per-endpoint serialisation (paginación, filtrado, forma de la respuesta).

components.name: Global error handling & problem responses
components.description: Centralised exception handling emitting a consistent problem envelope with a correlation id (manejo global de errores, identificador de correlación).

components.name: Risk, assumption and RAID tracking
components.description: Live RAID log with owners and mitigation for the delivery's known unknowns (riesgos, supuestos, RAID, mitigación).
